canonical_sampling.paired_axes: one event trajectory shared by X/Y prices
canonical_sampling.parallel_reproducibility: preserve serial event sequence and task IDs; ordered reduction; no resampling on a cache miss
canonical_sampling.streamed_request_replay: iter_b2_step_requests validates r events at a time with the existing explicit canonical API
canonical_sampling.remaining_materialization: existing monte_carlo_with_builder still materializes one Q*r event tuple; existing parallel MC queues all event tuples

canonical_sampling.rare_events: do not discard, trim, deduplicate, or silently oversample; a rare stratum design changes sampling and requires separate weights/variance validation

existing_statistics.mean: online Welford per metric and axis
existing_statistics.confidence_interval: not provided by the current B2 provider
